Polysomnography Report
Date: 09/09/2025
Patient: Earnest Schimmel, 69 y/o M

Attended PSG 09/09/2025. Study revealed severe sleep-disordered breathing. AHI 51.1/h. CA+MA 17% of total AHI. Oxygen desaturation nadir 82%. Sleep architecture fragmented with decreased REM and slow wave sleep. Periodic limb movements within normal limits. No significant arrhythmias noted. CPAP titration recommended given severity of OSA.
